workspace.name: EVD-0012 暫定Passive Skillカタログ

project_context.purpose: EVD-0008とSKL-0001のHuman承認済みPassive仕様から、後続のPlayer/Monster装備可能判定と実戦Balance検証に使うPassive Skill候補を段階別に展開して固定Evidence化する。
project_context.summary: 固定Requirementまで確定しているAdopted Passiveを68件の具体Passive Skill候補へ展開。Trigger Stat + Effect Stat等が未具体化のFrameworkは24件のTemplateとして別管理し、Requirementを推測しない。Rejected/Superseded系列6件は生成対象外として記録する。

current_focus.theme: EVD-0012 暫定Passive Skillカタログ
current_focus.goal: Passive候補を具体Requirement付きSkillと未具体化Framework Templateへ分離し、次のPlayer/Monster装備可能Evidenceの正規入力にする。

history.message: Created EVD-0012 Passive catalog from EVD-0008/SKL-0001. Concrete=68, framework templates=24, rejected series excluded=6. No Source/Game Data modification and no Battle/Simulation execution.

authority_basis.framework_rule: Passive is distinct from Active; basically 1 Skill = 1 Passive Effect. Threshold is acquisition Requirement only, not Active-style Effect Budget. Passive normally has no MP/Cooldown/CastTime/Target Range cost.
authority_basis.series_exclusivity_rule: Different levels of the same passiveSeriesId cannot be equipped simultaneously.
authority_basis.healing_boundary: Only 20Tick periodic HP/MP auto regeneration is retained as Passive healing. Other trigger healing and Passive Barrier remain excluded.
authority_basis.catalog_expansion_rule: Every Adopted series with a fully numeric single-stat Requirement is expanded into one concrete record per stage. Framework entries with unresolved Trigger Stat/Effect Stat are preserved as templates and are not made concrete by inference.
authority_basis.next_evidence_rule: Player/Monster equipability Evidence must use concrete_passive_records only. Framework templates require a later Human/Specification concrete instantiation before equipability calculation.
